_meta.description: Closed set of imperfective -ивать/-ывать verbs with a contested root-vowel alternation (Rozental §172.2). Two sub-families, both folded into one lexicon keyed by the standard (norm) infinitive with the corruption always going norm -> marked: (1) 'o_exception' — verbs that RESIST the otherwise-productive o->a alternation (обусловливать, узаконивать, ...); keeping the root 'o' is the prescriptive norm, and the colloquial/journalistic overgeneralization to 'a' (обуславливать) is the marked variant. (2) 'a_regular' — verbs where the o->a alternation IS the prescriptive norm (затрагивать, опаздывать, ...); FAILING to alternate (keeping 'o': затрогивать, опоздывать) is the hypercorrected/marked error. Each pair differs from its norm at exactly one character position (verified at load time); that position is a fixed offset from the start of the word and holds across the verb's entire paradigm (conjugated forms, participles, gerunds), since prefixes/roots never shift and only material after the alternating vowel varies with inflection. A subset of the transitive lexemes is frequently used reflexively (сосредоточиваться, затрагиваться, оспариваться, устраиваться, осваиваться, приурочиваться, застраиваться, удваиваться, утраиваться, удостаиваться, обеспокоиваться, озабочиваться); stanza lemmatizes those tokens under the -ся form, which is a different dictionary string than the transitive infinitive, so each is listed as its own lexicon entry rather than being derived from the transitive pair.
_meta.source: manual curation cross-checked against pymorphy3 (dictionary entries and/or KnownSuffixAnalyzer heuristic recognition for both the norm and marked infinitive)
